Maple Whipped Butter
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, January 2, 2010 - 12:42am

Ingredients




1 cup Butter
1/4 teaspoon Gelatin powder, unsweetened
1 1/4 cups Maple syrup
1 teaspoon Cold water

Preparation

1 In an electric mixer until fluffy. Slowly drizzle maple syrup on butter. 2 Soak gelatin in cold water, then dissolve over hot water. Cool slightly and add slowly to butter. Mix well. 3 Makes about 2 cups.
